Overview
The WHO South-East Asia Region: Climate and Health Regional Profile offers an insightful overview of how governments in the Region are progressing in managing these risks. The findings on critical climate change and health indicators are designed to help policy-makers to make well-informed decisions about implementing effective policies and strategies.
